traits.name: Assassinate
traits.text: During its first turn, the assassin has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the assassin scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.text: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.text: The assassin deals an extra 13 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the assassin that isn't incapacitated and the assassin doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
Through his Tiefling Legacy Düwel can cast spells. His spellcasting ability is INT (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit). He can cast th efollowing spells:
> * At will: _Fire Bolt, Thaumaturgy_
> * 1/day: _Hellish Rebuke, Darkness_

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The assassin makes two shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.text: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Edison "Eddie" Pulver

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.text: Eddie has advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves against magic.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Eddie can make up to 2 attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, one target, range 1,5 m, thrown (6 m/ 18 m), _Hit:_ 1d4 + 3 piercing damage.

actions.name: Self-Made Crossbow
actions.text: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, one targe, range (9 m/96 m), _Hit:_ 1d8 + 3 piercing damage, ignores _loading_ property.

actions.name: Weapon Invention
actions.text:
Eddie uses 1 of the following option (1d6 to choose). Every choice once per day.
> 1. Smoke Grenade: Eddie throws a smoke grenade up to 18 m. The hit area gets heavily obscured within 6 m radius of the target. Moderate wind disperses in 4 rounds, strong wind in 1 round.
> 2. Gnomengrenade: Eddie throws the Gnomengrenade up to 18 m. The grenade explodes on impact and unleashes the following effects:
> a. Every creature in the blast radius of 6 m must make a DC 13 CON saving throw or take 4d6 thunder damage and be _deafend_ for 1 min. On a success only half the damage and not _deafend_.
> b. 2 random effects from the Wild Magic Table effect the impact suroundings. (reroll splicates)
> 3. Alchemist Fire: Eddie throws a flask of Alchemist Fire. _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, range (1,5 m/9 m), one target, _Hit:_ 1d4 fire damage and 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of the targets turns until extinguished with a DC 13 DEX saving throw.
> 4. Shatter Grenade: Eddie throws a shatter grenade up to 18 m. The grenade explodes on impact and every creature within the blast radius of 6 m must make a DC 13 CON saving throw or be knocked _prone_ and pushed away from the grenade by 3 m.
> 5. Glue Bomb: Eddie throws a glue bomb up to 18 m. The hit area within a 6 m radius becomes difficult terrain and every creature within the area makes a DC 13 Dex saving throw or gets _restrained_ for 10 min. The glue dissolves after 10 min or after some alcohol was applied to the glue. A DC 13 STR saving throw can be done by hit creatures as an action each turn to escape the glue.
> 6. Healing Bomb: Eddie throws a healing bomb up to 18 m. The bomb explodes on impact. Every ally of Eddie in 6 m of the impact regains 4d4 + 4 hit points.

reactions.name: Emergency Exit (2/day)
reactions.text: Eddie can safely teleport to an unoccupied space in 9 m he knows of.

reactions.name: Flash of Genius
reactions.text: If he or another creature he can see within 30 feet of Eddie makes an ability check or a saving throw, he can use his reaction to add +4 to the roll.

name: Ladrian Smoke

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/day)
traits.text: If Ladrian fals a saving throw, he can chosse to succeed it instead.

traits.name: Second Wind (1/day)
traits.text: Ladrian gathers his stamina and regains 1d10 + 4 hit points.

traits.name: Action Surge (1/day)
traits.text: Ladrian pushes his body to the limits and can make 1 extra action this turn.

traits.name: Leadership (1/day)
traits.text: For 1 min, Ladrian utters a special command or warning a nonhostile creature that he can see within 9 m of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d6 to its roll provided it can hear him. This effect ends if the knight is _incapacitated_.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Ladrian makes two attacks.

actions.name: Longsword, +1
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +10 to hit, reach 1,5 m, one target. _Hit:_ 1d8 + 7 slashing damage

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: Ladrian exhales fire in a 9 m cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 DEX saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 3d6 fire damage, on a successful save half.

reactions.name: Retreat
reactions.text: Ladrian can shout "Retreat" and all his allies that can hear him wihin 18 m immediatly take their reaction, if possbile, to Disengage the combat.

name: Marlowe Avon

traits.name: Jack of All Trades
traits.text: Marlowe adds +1 to any skill check he is not proficient in.

traits.name: Words of Terror (1/day)
traits.text: Marlowe instills fear of a specific creature in a humanoid target he can talk to for at least 1 min. The target must make a WIS saving throw or is _frightened_ for 1 h or until it or an ally gets attacked. On a successful save the target doesn't know of the attempt.

traits.name: Bardic Inspiration (3/day)
traits.text: Marlowe can give a Bardic Inspiration die (1d8) to an ally in 18 m, that can hear him. The target can use the die as a bonus for one d20 roll in the next 10 min.

traits.name: Magical Inspiration
traits.text: A creature that has Marlowe's Bardic Inspiration can roll it add the roll to healed hit points or damage dealt.

traits.name: Psychic Blades
traits.text: Marlowe can spend 1 use of his "Bardic Inspiration" and add 3d6 psychic damage to a weapon attack that hits.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
Marlowe is a 8th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is CHA (spell save DC 14, +5 to hit). He knows the following spells:
> * Cantrips (at will): _Mage Hand_, _Message_, _Vicious Mockery_
> * 1st Level (4/day): _Dissonant Whispers_, _Faerie Fire_, _Sleep_, _Tashas Hideous Laughter_
> * 2nd Level (3/day): _Crown of Madness_, _Mirror Image_, _Shatter_
> * 3rd Level (3/day): _Antagonize_, _Fear_, _Motivational Speech_
> * 4th Level (2/day): _Confusion_, _Greater Invisibility_

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ + 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1 target. _Hit:_ 1d8 + 2 piercing damage

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.text: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach (9 m/ 36 m), 1 target. _Hit:_ 1d6 + 2 piercing damage

actions.name: Countercharm
actions.text: Marlowe and any allies, that can hear him, within 9 m have advantage on saving throws against _frightened_ or _charmed_. This effect lasts for one round or until _incapacitated_, _silenced_ or ended voluntarily.

reactions.name: Mantle of Whispers (1/day)
reactions.text:
A humanoid that dies within 9 m of Marlowe, he can take the shadow and persona of the dead humanoid for 1 h or until ended as a bonus action. He gets all information the dead would share with a random acquaintance (no secrets).
He gets a +5 to a counter Deception check against an Insight Check.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: Marlowe adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit. He must ne wielding his rapier to do this.

name: Satan Snake

traits.name: Primal Surge
traits.text:
Magic flows through the Snake and gives it the following benefits for 10 min:
- **Hulking Behemoth**: The Snake grows to Huge size and gains 20 temporary HP. If there is not enough room for huge it takes up the maximum possible space.
- **Mauler**: All attacks deal one corresponding hit die damage more.
- **Titanic Stride**: The walking speed increases by 10 ft.

actions.name: Mutliattack
actions.text: The Satan Snake can make 2 attacks per turn: One with its bite and one with its tail or constrict attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 1,5 m, one target. _Hit:_ 1d8+2 piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text: _Melee Weapon attack_: +6 to hit, reach 3 m, one target. _Hit_: 1d6+2 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack_: +6 to hit, reach 1,5 m, one creature. _Hit_: 2d8 + 2 bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the snake can’t constrict another target.

reactions.name: Intercept Attack
reactions.text: When a creature the Snake can see hits a target with an attack, and the target is within 5 feet of the Snake, the target instead takes half the damage. The Snake takes the remainder of the damage.

name: Maria Magdalena

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
Maria is an 18th-level Spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is WIS (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit). She has the following spells prepared:
- Cantrips (at will): _Druidcraft, Poison Spray, Infestation, Shillelagh_
- 1st Level (4 slots): _Speak with Animals, Faerie Fire, Entangle, Thunderwave_
- 2nd Level (3 slots): _Heat Metal, Wither and Bloom, Darkvision, Hold Person, Blindness/Deafness_
- 3rd Level (3 slots): _Feign Death, Aura of Vitality, Plant Growth, Water Breathing, Conjure Animals_
- 4th Level (3 slots): _Polymorph, Stoneskin, Blight, Confusion_
- 5th Level (3 slots): _Insect Plague, Tree Stride, Wrath of Nature, Scrying, Awaken_
- 6th Level (1 slot): _Heal, Wall of Thorns, Flesh to Stone_
- 7th Level (1 slot): _Symbol_
- 8th Level (1 slot): _Feeblemind_
- 9th Level (1 slot): _Foresight_

actions.name: Shillelagh (Staff)
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack_: +9 to hit, reach 1,5 m, one target. _Hit_: 1d8 + 5 slashing damage.

actions.name: Wildfire
actions.text: _Ranged Spell Attack_: +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. _Hit_: 6d6 + 5 fire damage, and the target is blinded until the start of the druid’s next turn.

actions.name: Change Shape (2/Day)
actions.text:
Maria magically polymorphs into a beast or elemental with a CR of 6 or less, and can remain in this form for up to 9 hours. Her equipment melds with her new form. Maria reverts to her true form if she dies or falls unconscious. Maria can revert to her true form using a Bonus Action on her turn.
While in the new form, Maria retains its game statistics and ability to speak, only her AC, movement modes, STR, and DEX are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any special senses, proficiencies, traits, actions, and reactions (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks. It can cast its spells with verbal or somatic components in its new form.
The new form’s attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

actions.name: Symbiotic Entity
actions.text:
As an Action, Maria can expend a use of her "Change Shape" feature to awaken her spores and she gains 72 temporary HP. While this feature is active, Maria gains the following benefits:
- When Maria deals damage with its "Halo of Spores", she rolls the damage die a second time and adds it to the total.
- Maria' melee weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 poison damage to any target they hit.

reactions.name: Halo of Spores
reactions.text: A creature you can see in 3 m from you or starts its turn there must make a CON saving throw or take 1d10 necrotic damage.

reactions.name: Fungal Infestation (5/day)
reactions.text: Her Spores animate a Small or Medium dead Beast or Humanoid within 3 m of her to a zombie. It gains 1 HP and after 1 h it dies. It moves directly after Maria and is mentally commanded by her.

legendary_actions.name: Attacks and Spells
legendary_actions.text: She attacks with her Staff, Wildfire or casts any one spell from her list.

legendary_actions.name: Misty Escape
legendary_actions.text: After she takes damage, Maria can cast "Misty Step" to escape more damage.

legendary_actions.name: Spreading Spores
legendary_actions.text: While the "Symbiotic Entity" feature is active, Maria can hurl spores up to 9 m away, where they swirl in a 3 m cube for 1 min. Whenever a creature moves into the cube or starts its turn there, that creature takes "Halo of Spores" damage, unless the creature succeeds on a CON saving throw (DC 17). A creature can take this damage no more than once per turn.

legendary_description: The monster can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The monster regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
